rules:
  - id: "vuln-conform-4819d51b"
    pattern: >
      function_declaration
      |>
      if_statement

      binary_expression

      identifier(name="segment")
    pattern-not: >
      function_declaration
      |>
      if_statement
      |>
      binary_expression
      |>
      identifier(name="segment")
      |>
      not(
        binary_expression(
          operator="!==",
          left=string(value="__proto__"),
          right=identifier(name="segment")
        )
      )
    languages: ["typescript"]
    message: >
      The function `formData` in `formdata.ts` of the `conform-dom` package of the `conform` library has a vulnerability where it allows overwriting built-in properties (`__proto__`, `constructor`, `prototype`) in the object graph. This can lead to various security risks such as prototype pollution. To fix this issue, make sure that the `segment` variable is not equal to these built-in property names.
    severity: ERROR
    metadata:

      category: security
      cwe: [94]
      owasp: [Injection]
      references: [https://owasp.org/www-community/attacks/XML_External_Entity_%28XXE%29]

+			if (
+				typeof segment !== 'undefined' &&
+				segment !== '' &&
+				segment !== '__proto__' &&
+				segment !== 'constructor' &&
+				segment !== 'prototype'
+			) {
-				? pointer[key] ?? (typeof nextKey === 'number' ? [] : {})
+				? Object.hasOwn(pointer, key)
+					? pointer[key]

+					? []
+					: {}
